technical_papers.title: Speech Recognition-based Billing System: A multi-model design and ﻿ implementation

details.description:
Speech recognition has emerged as a cutting-edge area of 
research with wide-ranging applications. In this work, we 
propose a billing system, which has the capability to 
generate a bill by taking the customer’s voice as the input 
source. The system aims to implement a multi-model 
approach in order to avoid conflicts in recognition i.e., 
having individual models (also considered as ‘subjects’) 
that recognizes the necessary speech. Also, the proposed 
system is incorporated with Google’s speech to text 
model as it also has two custom-trained models that were 
trained using 1 Dimensional CNN. This system is also 
successful in recognizing different dialects of global 
pronunciations. To make it more interactive with the 
customer or the user, the system has a ‘text-to-speech’ 
technology that can speak or produce the given 
sentence(s) in the form of speech.

technical_papers.title: Prediction of Parkinson's disease Using Machine Learning Models  - A Classifier Analysis

details.description:
Among the chronic nervous system diseases, Parkinson’s Disease (PD) is known for
its progressiveness in impairing the speech ability, gait as well as the complex muscle
and nerve actions.
An early diagnosis of PD will help in reducing the symptoms.
Telemedicine offers a cost-effective and convenient approach and several studies have
used dysphonic features to remotely detect PD. 
In this study, we have used a data set from Kaggle which included voice measurements from 31 people of whom 23 were diagnosed with PD. The data set included 22 different attributes pertaining to voice measurements including the pitch period entropy with 195 voice recordings for each of the individuals.
The data set was evaluated with four different supervised classification machine learning (ML) models namely Random Forest, XGBoost, SVM, and Decision Tree. 
The XGBoost classifier model was found to be highly efficient in the precise classification of PD with an accuracy of 0.93.

projects.title: GRAPHICAL PASSWORD AUTHENTICATION USING MACHINE LEARNING

details.description: Graphical Password Authentication project that provides an additional layer of security to alphanumeric passwords by using images as passwords. With this project, users can create a unique and personalized image password by selecting images from a pre-defined set. This password can then be used in combination with a traditional alphanumeric password for enhanced security. This project is ideal for applications where password protection is critical, such as online banking, e-commerce.

projects.title: Design and Development of solar powered vacuum and wet cleaning robot

details.description: A dual-function cleaning robot, which functions both as a vacuum cleaner and a wet floor cleaner. The robot is powered by a solar panel and is equipped with an Arduino UNO, a motor driver shield, and DC motors. An ultrasonic sensor was also integrated for obstacle detection. The vacuum function employs suction to remove dust and debris from floors, while the wet floor cleaning function uses wipers and a small pump to dispense water and clean the surface.

projects.title: Early Stage Detection of PCOS Using Machine Learning

details.description: The proposed system that can help in the early detection of PCOS treatment with the help of ultrasound ovary images. To detect whether a woman is suffering from PCOS, 3 different machine learning classifiers like Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and Logistic Regression, and two different Convolution Neural Network algorithms like Sequential CNN and Inception V3 have been used.
We created a website in which the user uploads a picture of the food item and using that picture we calculate the calories by classifying the food item using neural networks.

We as a team of four built a website that provides a questionnaire and asks users to complete it and then using an ML algorithm we predict the stress level and provide tips based on different important measurements.

details.description: Smart Claim: An app simplifying accident reporting and insurance claims. Capture and send photos of the scene for verification by police, ensuring only legitimate accidents are reported. Seamlessly integrates with insurers for instant claim processing and payout, eliminating delays and paperwork. User-friendly interface and real-time communication enhance efficiency. Revolutionizing traditional approaches for the benefit of individuals and insurers.

technical_papers.title: RESNET based Crop Disease Detection models using Convolutional Neural Networks

details.description: This paper compares popular CNN architectures and custom models, with RESNET101 and Adam optimizer emerging as top performers on the Plant-Village dataset. Achieving high F1-scores (macro: 0.9417, micro: 0.9425) and accuracy (94.25%), this study innovatively emphasizes class-wise metric analysis. The methodology holds promise for broader agricultural applications, aiding early disease detection for sustainable crop management.
